title: Apple Cocktail: Maestra
ldInstructionsRaw: Combine the first 5 ingredients in a shaker, then dry shake (without ice). Add ice, then shake again to chill. Double strain into a glass, top with soda, then garnish.
Apple syrup: Cut 1 granny smith apple into chunks, then juice. Combine the juice with equal parts of granulated sugar by weight. Blend briefly to emulsify.
